description: Conservation of catalytic and substituted positions in both nematode clades, with binomial tests against each clade's own domain background
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import binomtest
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
REF1=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O62415.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
REF6=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q20968.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
M1=pd.read_csv("lys1clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M1.columns=[int(c) for c in M1.columns]
M6=pd.read_csv("lys6clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M6.columns=[int(c) for c in M6.columns]
cons1=pd.Series({p:(M1[p]==REF1[p-1]).mean() for p in M1.columns})
cons6=pd.Series({p:(M6[p]==REF6[p-1]).mean() for p in M6.columns})
dom1=cons1.loc[59:277]; dom6=cons6.loc[10:214]
def pct(s,p): return float((s<s.loc[p]).mean()*100)

rows=[]
for clade,cons,dom,ref,items in [
  ("LYS-1 clade (n=%d)"%len(M1),cons1,dom1,REF1,
     [(64,"catalytic Asp1 position, Asp retained"),(154,"catalytic Asp2 position, now Gln"),
      (157,"catalytic Glu position, now Ser"),(117,"Glu117"),(194,"Asp194"),(260,"Asp260 (Asp64 partner)")]),
  ("LYS-6 clade (n=%d)"%len(M6),cons6,dom6,REF6,
     [(22,"catalytic Asp1"),(112,"catalytic Asp2"),(114,"catalytic Glu"),(209,"Asp209 (Asp22 partner)")])]:
    for p,lab in items:
        rows.append(dict(clade=clade,pos=p,ref_aa=ref[p-1],label=lab,
                         pct_identical=round(cons[p]*100,1),
                         domain_background=round(dom.mean()*100,1),
                         percentile_in_domain=round(pct(dom,p),1)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); T.to_csv("clade_position_conservation_table.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print(T.to_string(index=False))

print("\nOne-sided binomial tests against the clade's own GH25-domain background identity")
for pos,aa,M,dom,n in [(154,"Q",M1,dom1,len(M1)),(157,"S",M1,dom1,len(M1)),(64,"D",M1,dom1,len(M1))]:
    k=int((M[pos]==aa).sum()); b=binomtest(k,n,dom.mean(),alternative="greater")
    print(f"  LYS-1 clade {aa}{pos}: {k}/{n} = {100*k/n:.1f}% vs background {dom.mean()*100:.1f}%, p = {b.pvalue:.3g}")
for pos,aa in [(112,"D"),(114,"E")]:
    k=int((M6[pos]==aa).sum()); b=binomtest(k,len(M6),dom6.mean(),alternative="greater")
    print(f"  LYS-6 clade {aa}{pos}: {k}/{len(M6)} = {100*k/len(M6):.1f}% vs background {dom6.mean()*100:.1f}%, p = {b.pvalue:.3g}")

# region-wise identity in the LYS-1 clade
print("\nLYS-1 clade mean identity by region")
for a,b_,lab in [(17,58,"N-terminal extension (17-58)"),(59,277,"GH25 domain (59-277)"),(278,298,"C-terminal tail (278-298)")]:
    print(f"  {lab:<32s} {cons1.loc[a:b_].mean()*100:5.1f}%")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12.5,6.6))
for ax,cons,title,marks,dom in [
  (axes[0],cons1,"LYS-1 clade (n=162) aligned to C. elegans LYS-1: the DEAD site is as conserved as a live one",
     [(64,"Asp64\nretained","#2a6f4e"),(154,"Gln154\nreplaces Asp","#c0392b"),(157,"Ser157\nreplaces Glu","#c0392b"),(117,"Glu117","#2a6f4e")],dom1),
  (axes[1],cons6,"LYS-6 clade (n=138) aligned to C. elegans LYS-6: intact catalytic triad",
     [(22,"Asp22","#2a6f4e"),(112,"Asp112","#2a6f4e"),(114,"Glu114","#2a6f4e")],dom6)]:
    ax.fill_between(cons.index,0,cons.values*100,color="#c9c9c9",lw=0)
    ax.plot(cons.index,cons.values*100,color="#4a4a4a",lw=0.7)
    ax.axhline(dom.mean()*100,color="#1f6fb2",lw=1.1,ls="--")
    ax.text(cons.index.max(),dom.mean()*100+2,f"domain background {dom.mean()*100:.0f}%",
            color="#1f6fb2",fontsize=8,ha="right")
    for p,lab,c in marks:
        ax.vlines(p,0,cons[p]*100,color=c,lw=1.8)
        ax.scatter([p],[cons[p]*100],color=c,s=22,zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(lab,(p,cons[p]*100),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,6),
                    fontsize=7.5,color=c,ha="center")
    ax.set_title(title,loc="left",fontsize=10); ax.set_ylabel("% identical to reference"); ax.set_ylim(0,118)
    ax.set_yticks([0,25,50,75,100])
axes[1].set_xlabel("reference residue position")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
